as_told.title: John Alexander knew about Rendlesham before anyone else

plain: John B. Alexander, whom Michels calls a Colonel, is said to have known about Rendlesham, a reported UFO incident near RAF Woodbridge in England in 1980, before almost anyone else in the United States. Michels says this himself on three episodes. Once he traces it to a well-connected friend he does not name, who said Alexander "gave the readout". The other two times he gives no source, and once he drops the limit to the United States and says Alexander knew "before anybody else".
